positive_findings: No writes to raw case records or frozen learning inputs in these four tools; outputs use new-artifact paths.
Evidence index selection uses admitted package, safe closure, UI action presence and deterministic A/seed/index ordering, not task success score.
Evidence index explicitly distinguishes learner action predictions from independently graded case-level fields.
Execution context checks exact six identities/30 indices, administrative legacy plus unique claims, case manifests and global worker process overlap.
Plots retain unknown/unscorable/task failure categories and separate registered cohort from paired compliance sensitivity.

findings.issue: Render accepts weak any-reference hashes and does not verify learning/truth-index/figure/evidence provenance; index does not independently validate complete qualified handoff lineage.
findings.recommendation: Use exact named references; rebuild handoff through existing read-only build_handoff and compare; validate figure/evidence sidecars and their input/output hashes; require independently bound truth archive index.

findings.issue: Entry guards do not all independently enforce full registered 180/540 plus per-condition90/270 or rebuild raw records; hard-coded prose/provenance can disagree with supplied data.
findings.recommendation: Reuse build_report equality validation for runs/conditions/overall/schedule; enforce registered totals and category exhaustion before rendering.

findings.issue: service_error_counts silently ignores malformed JSONL rows and can imply an exhaustive zero-error count.
findings.recommendation: Preserve parseable error counts and report malformed/missing rows as incomplete availability evidence.
